verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no general bulk-operation capability, such as batch API endpoints or Dashboard multi-select actions, for acting on many subscriptions, invoices, or customers at once. The migration toolkit and subscription import cover one-time data migration from other billing systems. That is a related but different feature and earns no credit toward general bulk operations. The API, CLI, and MCP server are developer building blocks, not a documented bulk-operation feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
